definitions.name: W3C.REDUCE
definitions.note: Bracket String reduced to normal form by deleting adjacent () and [] pairs (12 REPLACE passes cover 12 characters).

definitions.name: W3C.MAXV
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV MV 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Maximum of a non-empty numeric Vector, seeded with its first element so negatives work.

definitions.name: W3C.MINV
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV MV 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: Minimum of a non-empty numeric Vector, seeded with its first element.

definitions.name: W3C.JOINSP
definitions.note: Vector of words joined into one String with single spaces, no leading or trailing space.

definitions.name: W3C.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: One word: first letter upper case, the rest lower case.

definitions.name: W3C.PICK
definitions.body: 'TR' BIND 'WV' BIND WV '' TR SELECT [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER 0 GET
definitions.note: W Vector and truth Vector (W on bottom): the first element of W whose truth is TRUE.

definitions.name: W3C.MED
definitions.body: SORT 'SM' BIND SM LENGTH 'NM' BIND SM NM 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET SM NM 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle sorted values, which coincide for odd counts).

definitions.name: W3C.DIFFS
definitions.body: 'DX' BIND DX 0 GET 1 ADD 1 COLLECT DX -1 DROP CONCAT 'PV' BIND DX PV SUB
definitions.note: Vector of X[i] minus X[i-1]; the first entry is -1 so it always counts as a change.

definitions.name: W3C.STARTS
definitions.body: 'F' BIND 0 F LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE 'IX' BIND IX -1 F SELECT [ 0 LT NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Given a truth Vector, the indices at which it is TRUE, in order.

definitions.name: W3C.GAPS
definitions.body: 'X' BIND 0 X LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE 'I' BIND I -1 X [ NIL? NOT ] MAP SELECT -1 [ MAX ] SCAN 'CM' BIND I CM SUB
definitions.note: Readings Vector to, per position, the distance back to the last present reading (1 at the start of each gap, 0 on present readings).

solutions.brackets.depth: '(' '1 ' REPLACE '[' '1 ' REPLACE ')' '-1 ' REPLACE ']' '-1 ' REPLACE G0A.WORDS NUM 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: 'S' BIND S CHARS 'C' BIND 0 C LENGTH RANGE 0 C '' [ 2 COLLECT JOIN W3C.REDUCE ] SCAN 'N' BIND [ '' ] N CONCAT [ '' EQ ] MAP SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
